broad_unknown_build.notes: Broad unknown builds often benefit from initial exploration followed by iterative execution.

clear_bug_fix.notes: Clear repair missions often benefit from focused action with minimal planning overhead.

complex_architecture_work.notes: Architecture-heavy missions often benefit from stronger up-front structure.

multi-surface_delivery.notes: Multi-surface work often benefits from sequencing first, then parallelism once interfaces are clearer.

research_to_build.notes: Research-to-build missions benefit from bounded exploration before committing to implementation.
